verdict.rationale: Jira exposes REST APIs (jira-docs-1) and community feedback confirms they are genuinely useful for querying/automating ticket data (jira-comm-20), which supports headless/CI-style automation. However, there is no documented CLI, CI-specific tooling, or automation examples, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt for developers (jira-probe-1, jira-probe-2). Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs, official CLI or headless mode, discoverable API spec, and independent verification of automation reliability.
